content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Spartanburg

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and measurable project-management experience. Review PMI's eligibility criteria—typically a bachelor's degree paired with years of direct project leadership—to confirm you meet the baseline. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify your specific qualifications at no cost.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our sessions cover the entire PMI Body of Knowledge in a structured format, meeting PMI's contact-hour requirement. You'll engage with experienced instructors, ask questions in real time, and receive materials you'll reference during exam prep.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your formal training, submit your PMP application directly to PMI with your education and work-experience documentation. Pay the associated exam fee at the time of application. Our team will guide you through the online submission process and confirm all materials meet PMI's standards.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to sharpen your knowledge. Schedule your exam through Pearson VUE at a testing center convenient to you. We remain available to clarify difficult concepts right up to exam day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the three-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved activities—training, conferences, volunteer work, or published articles. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses and workshops to help you stay current and renew on schedule.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
